Roof members here (จันทัน/อกไก่/ตะเข้สัน/ตะเข้ราง/อะเส) are drawn as a schematic hip-roof framing diagram, not as individually grid-positioned segments the way a floor beam is — each member type is recorded ONCE below with its steel section and the overall plan area it covers ('A-D x 1-4'), rather than as N synthetic per-rafter segments the drawing itself does not enumerate. จันทัน (rafters) print an explicit spacing (@1.00m); the other members (ridge/hip/valley/wall-plate) are each a small number of individual pieces framing the hip, not a repeated/spaced member.
